tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Acid Splash
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You hurl a bubble of acid at a creature within range, dealing acid damage.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 acid damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Combustive Shot
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a small explosive projectile that deals fire damage on impact.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 fire damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Cryogenic Burst
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a small cryogenic projectile that deals cold damage and can slow the target.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 cold damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Electrical Burst
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a small electrical projectile that deals lightning damage and can stun the target.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Electroshock
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You deliver a small electrical shock to a creature within range, dealing lightning damage.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Haywire
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You send a small electrical pulse that can disrupt electronic devices and droids.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 lightning damage to droids and electronic devices

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Ion Blast
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a small ion projectile that deals ion damage and can disable electronic devices.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 ion damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Jet of Flame
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a small jet of flame that deals fire damage to a target within range.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 fire damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Mending
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to repair a small break or tear in an object.

effects.notes: Repair a small break or tear in an object

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Minor Hologram
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a small holographic image that can be used for communication or distraction.

effects.notes: Create a small holographic image at a point within range

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Poison Spray
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You spray a small amount of poison at a creature within range, dealing poison damage.

effects.notes: Deal 1d4 poison damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Target Lock
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to lock onto a target, granting advantage on your next attack against them.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next attack against the target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Ward
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a small energy ward that can absorb a small amount of damage.

effects.notes: Grant 1d4 temporary hit points to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Absorb Energy
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to absorb energy from an attack, converting it into temporary hit points.

effects.notes: Gain 2d4 temporary hit points

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Bacta Pack
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use a bacta pack to heal a creature's wounds.

effects.notes: Heal 2d4 hit points

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Cryogenic Wave
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a wave of cryogenic energy that deals cold damage to all creatures in a line.

effects.notes: Deal 2d4 cold damage to all creatures in a 60-foot line

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Energy Shield
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create an energy shield that can absorb damage and deflect attacks.

effects.notes: Gain 3d4 temporary hit points

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Expeditious Retreat
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to enhance your movement speed and agility.

effects.notes: Your speed is doubled for the duration

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Flame Sweep
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a sweeping wave of flame that deals fire damage to all creatures in a cone.

effects.notes: Deal 2d4 fire damage to all creatures in a 30-foot cone

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Homing Rockets
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire homing rockets that seek out and damage a target.

effects.notes: Deal 2d4 fire damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Kolto Pack
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use a kolto pack to heal a creature's wounds more effectively than a bacta pack.

effects.notes: Heal 3d4 hit points

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Oil Slick
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create an oil slick on the ground that can cause creatures to slip and fall.

effects.notes: Create difficult terrain in a 10-foot radius

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Overload
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You send an electrical overload that can damage and disable electronic devices.

effects.notes: Deal 2d4 lightning damage to electronic devices

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Spot the Weakness
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to analyze a target and identify their weaknesses.

effects.notes: Advantage on your next attack against the target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Tactical Barrier
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a tactical barrier that can provide cover and protection.

effects.notes: Create half cover in a 10-foot radius

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Tracer Bolt
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a tracer bolt that deals damage and marks the target for your allies.

effects.notes: Deal 2d4 energy damage and mark target for allies

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Acid Dart
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You fire a dart filled with acid that deals acid damage and can corrode armor.

effects.notes: Deal 3d4 acid damage to target

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Capacity Boost
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to boost a creature's physical or mental capacity.

effects.notes: Target gains +2 to one ability score of your choice

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Darkvision
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to enhance a creature's vision, allowing them to see in darkness.

effects.notes: Target gains darkvision out to 60 feet

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Electromesh
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create an electromagnetic mesh that can trap and damage creatures.

effects.notes: Create an electromagnetic field in a 10-foot radius

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Enhance Droid
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to enhance a droid's capabilities and performance.

effects.notes: Droid gains +2 to all ability scores

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Infiltrate
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to enhance your stealth and infiltration capabilities.

effects.notes: Gain +2 to Stealth checks

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Mirror Image
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create holographic duplicates of yourself to confuse enemies.

effects.notes: Create 3 holographic copies of yourself

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Paralyze Humanoid
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You use technology to paralyze a humanoid creature, preventing them from moving or acting.

effects.notes: Target must be humanoid

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Scramble Interface
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You send a scramble signal that can disrupt and disable electronic interfaces.

effects.notes: Deal 3d4 lightning damage to electronic devices

tech_powers_comprehensive.name: Shatter
tech_powers_comprehensive.description: You create a sonic blast that can damage creatures and shatter objects.

effects.notes: Deal 3d4 thunder damage to target
